title: Remove the footer assistant and the vision demo from the UI
goal: The footer no longer shows the assistant or the camera demo
acceptance: Owner decision 2026-11-26 in chat: "A" (retire the on-device assistant and the vision demo), with "vision capabilities ideally on nerv too".
src/app/shared/UI/llm-ui/ and src/app/shared/UI/vision-ui/ are deleted with their templates; footer.ts and footer.html no longer import or render them
No other component references them; app.spec.ts still passes
Italian: the removed assistant had an English-only keyword gate; nothing Italian-facing remains in the footer, so no Italian case is owed (stated in F-023)
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption
Something outside the assistant and demo that still needs the runtime goes to the owner, not removed silently

effort.basis: Two standalone components (about 600 lines) and a footer edit. Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed (single-PR removal near 0.25–0.5 h). Not a measurement.
